statement: The lead author reports that some numerical values in the publication were intentionally presented approximately or differently to make straightforward copying of the method/technique more difficult, and that original values could be supplied upon request.
evidence_status: author testimony; not independently verified by repository data
scope: Interpretation of differences between laboratory/device-side records and publication-derived values
handling_rules: Preserve Dataset A laboratory/device-side source values unchanged.
Preserve Dataset B publication-derived values unchanged.
Store any correspondence or approximate reconciliation in a separate traceable layer.
Do not infer a numeric correction solely from the size of a discrepancy.
Do not present this statement as an independently verified experimental finding.
